# Contributing to Generals of Chaos

Thanks for taking the time to contribute.

## Start here

- New repositories should begin from
  [GOC-Base-Repo-Template](https://github.com/Lipford-Dutch/GOC-Base-Repo-Template).
- Follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- Questions that are not a bug or a feature request belong in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/Lipford-Dutch/.github/discussions).
- How-to write-ups belong in the
  [guide library](https://lipford-dutch.github.io/goc-guide-library/).

## Pull requests

1. Branch from the repository's default branch.
2. Keep the change focused. Match the project's existing tests, lint and docs.
3. Fill in the pull request template. Link the issue or discussion when there is one.
4. Do not commit secrets, credentials, private IP addresses, or customer data.
5. Wait for review from a maintainer before merging. Do not force-push to `main`.

## Security

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability.
